 Revanth takes political battle to Harish’s turf, to unveil projects worth ₹544cr in Siddipet

 Roushan Ali / Nov 18, 2026, 23:22 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Hyderabad: Chief minister A Revanth Reddy will address a public meeting on Thursday in Siddipet, the assembly constituency represented by BRS leader T Harish Rao, as the Congress steps up its political outreach in constituencies held by key opposition leaders. In Sept, Revanth addressed a public meeting in Sircilla, represented by BRS working president KT Rama Rao. He is also planning a rally in Gajwel, the constituency represented by former chief minister and BRS president K Chandrasekhar Rao. During his Siddipet visit, the CM will launch the Indiramma family insurance scheme, aimed at covering one crore families across Telangana , and begin distributing Indiramma sarees. He will also lay foundation stones for development projects worth ₹451 crore and inaugurate completed works worth ₹93 crore. Among the major projects are Young India Integrated Residential Schools in Dubbak and Siddipet constituencies, with an investment of ₹200 crore each. He will also launch works for construction of additional classrooms in seven govt schools at a cost of ₹15.4 crore and six tahsildar office buildings at a cost of ₹13.5 crore. Join conversation

 Foundation stones will also be laid for Telangana Public Schools in Chinnakodur and Doultabad mandals, costing ₹7.5 crore and ₹7.8 crore respectively. Three electrical substations in Jangaon constituency, estimated at ₹6.8 crore, are also among the projects. The CM will inaugurate 14 electrical substations in Siddipet district, built at ₹54.6 crore, besides a guest house at Komuravelli Mallanna temple (₹14.3 crore) and a queue complex (₹12 crore). Other inaugurations include buildings for 53 village-level women’s self-help groups (₹6.5 crore), a Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya building in Rayapole mandal (₹3.8 crore) and an electricity department divisional office in Gajwel (₹1.6 crore).
